name: OATH OF DAYBREAK inhabited architecture kit
delta: Decomposes existing broad architecture requirement into regional load-path assemblies, common connection contract, civic/residential/work uses and reviewable acceptance; no new realm, capital or duplicated production asset.
purpose: Marble arcades, sun-shading colonnades and visible public thresholds frame civic authority. Shelters and clinics share the same durable materials as courts, preventing the architecture from implying that only judgment deserves grandeur.

reference_evidence.observed: Pale colonnades, pointed fabric canopies and gold-colored trim frame stepped courts, pools and narrow trees.
missing: Production geometry, UVs, collision, rig/animation where relevant and engine tests

construction: Stone piers and thin removable facing carry distinct structural and decorative roles; canopy ties avoid public head clearance.

proposed_physical_scale.note: Clear widths measured after trim; regional chambers/landmarks can vary but must preserve approved traversal capsule and bypass.

variants.assembly: Housing includes mixed-income courtyard blocks and refuge rooms, with ward sockets and shared kitchens. Sanctuary status protects access during conflict; players cannot place judgment effects that police other players' identities or movement.
courthouse, clinic and shelter have equally readable access
Ward engraving desk, public aid station, lamp maintenance cart
Reversible facade and service closure overlays; stable public corridor remains; no player-content loss.

collision: Static simplified occupied shell; stairs use smooth traversal proxy plus foot-placement surface.
Door sweeps, interaction volumes and damageable segments separate.
All variants preserve exits; collision readiness precedes appearance.
animation: Only authored shutters, sails, screens, mechanisms and ambient attachments animate; pivots/limits/swept bounds mandatory.
Freeze moving decor safely at distant LOD without changing authoritative mechanism state.
lod: LOD0 interaction-facing detail; LOD1 simplified joints; LOD2 skyline mass; HLOD group only after visual/occlusion tests.
Door/landing/socket transforms and hazard tells unchanged at all LODs.
Thresholds selected from screen-space error with hysteresis after hardware choice; no fixed-distance universal promise.

performance.cost_class: high: bespoke modular silhouette and state integration
performance.acceptance: Record CPU/GPU frame-time distribution, resident bytes, draw/material counts and transition stalls on selected target hardware at fixed camera/build/revision. No benchmark or budget compliance is asserted.
performance.fallback: Reduce decoration, distant animation and shadow/transparency quality before critical geometry, exit signs or hazard cues.

acceptance: Match directly observed overview silhouette/material hierarchy in neutral-light comparison; obtain exact-art review.
Pass ASSET_CONSTRUCTION_HANDBOOK.md connection, door, stair, socket, UV, collision, LOD and state gates.
One residential, one civic and one work assembly proves kit flexibility; these are test fixtures, not arbitrary building quotas.
Keep grounded ordinary entry and protected service corridor through authored event states.
